newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end firm as crude futures rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end firm as crude futures rally.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer on gains in crude futures on Tuesday, traders said.

Cracked fuel oil markets were stable but trade was dull. Firmer crude and high sulphur cargo pricing gave the market an initial upside tendency, but this was countered by a weaker nearby paper market and relaxed buying interest.
Gas oil barges gained even though premiums eased by up to 50 cents because of stronger futures.
Gasoline was slightly higher with Eurograde barges trading at $210, $211 fob ARA in late trade as crude future gains boosted the market. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
